summary: Build AI risk registers, control maps and compliance evidence using NIST and ISO frameworks. Explore the five-day training course.
lede: AI risk management gives governance leads, model risk analysts and compliance professionals a structured way to assess AI systems and connect risks to operational controls. Practical exercises cover scoping use cases, recording risk assessments, mapping obligations to control owners, documenting human oversight, and preparing monitoring and incident records across the AI lifecycle.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course suits professionals who assess, govern, procure or monitor AI systems and need to connect AI risks with operational controls and compliance evidence.
modules: NIST AI RMF and Lifecycle Governance
prerequisites: Working knowledge of organizational risk, compliance or AI system workflows is recommended. No coding or programming is required; exercises use structured assessment records and spreadsheet-based risk scoring.
